battle.name: 楊仲緒起義
battle.brief: 大業十一年二月戊辰，涿郡豪帥楊仲緒率眾萬餘攻北平郡城，隋廷以滑國公李景率軍赴援；守軍以秦弩列陣城頭，居高壓制攻城步卒，叛軍攻具屢不得上城牆。二月之役中叛軍野戰失利，楊仲緒被斬，幽州起義隨之瓦解。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這是一場隋朝中央與幽州地方起義勢力之間的戰事，交戰重心在河北北端的北平郡城。隋朝一方以滑國公李景為主將，率領幽燕一線的鎮守官軍與郡兵赴援；北平郡城的守備則由郡丞、縣令以下的地方官員主持，聽尚書令與兵部節度，必要時自鄰郡調兵入援。起義一方由幽州豪帥楊仲緒聚眾而起，《隋書》卷四與《北史》卷十二都記其「率眾萬餘」，人多為北邊州縣的逃兵、逃戶，以及久戍邊外之後流散內地的軍人與民戶，臨時合夥，既無統一編制，也沒有自己的後勤體系。與此同時，北方另有上谷人王須拔自稱漫天王、國號燕，賊帥魏刁兒自稱歷山飛，兩部眾各十餘萬，北連突厥、南寇趙郡，說明大業十一年前後河北至塞北的叛亂已互相呼應。隋廷把幽州當作北方重鎮，屯糧、備馬、置郡兵，才勉強維持得住在北平一線的快速反應能力。
countriesEn: This was a clash between the central Sui government and a locally raised rebel force, fought out at the walled seat of Beiping Commandery on the northern edge of Hebei. On the Sui side the commander was the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, who brought up the garrison troops and commandery levies of the You-Yan frontier; the defence of the walled city itself was in the hands of local officials, the commandery vice-prefect and the magistrate of the seat, answerable to the Department of State Affairs and the Ministry of War, with reinforcements drawn in from neighbouring commanderies when needed. The insurgents were mustered by Yang Zhongxu, a local magnate of Youzhou. Both the Book of Sui, juan 4, and the History of the Northern Dynasties, juan 12, record that he 「led more than ten thousand men」 — deserters and absentees from the northern prefectures and counties, together with soldiers and households scattered back into the interior after long garrison duty on the frontier, hastily banded together, without a unified order of battle and without any logistic system of their own. At the same time, further north, Wang Xu Ba of Shanggu proclaimed himself the King of Lang and founded the state of Yan, while the rebel leader Wei Diao'er called himself the Flying of Lishan; each of the two drew more than a hundred thousand men, reaching towards the Turks to the north and raiding Zhao Commandery to the south. The Sui had made Youzhou a heavy northern garrison, with stored grain, remounted horses and commandery levies; only that apparatus allowed the government to react quickly on the Beiping front.
people: 楊仲緒是幽州涿郡人，本地豪帥，六世紀末至615年間在北方邊地頗有勢力，是隋末民變中幽州起義的領袖。大業十一年二月戊辰，他舉兵眾萬餘進攻北平郡城，兵敗被斬，起義隨之瓦解。史籍只留下他的名字與結局，沒有留下年齡、官職或發兵經過的細節，這一點在引用時不宜替他補寫。擊破他的李景是隋廷鎮守幽燕的老將，隋文帝末年已授柱國、右武衛大將軍，掌禁軍宿衛；大業九年高句麗入犯後軍時，朝廷敕令他為「後拒」，率軍殿後，擋住追擊的追兵。此後他屢次在皇帝遠征與邊防最吃緊的位置上當值，到大業十一年已封滑國公，二月戊辰率軍平定北平之亂。同一個月份，隋煬帝仍在東都與北方巡幸之間來回，無法親臨幽燕；同年八月突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬圍雁門，官軍頻戰不利，直到九月圍解為止，可見中央對北方的調度能力已在崩解邊緣。記錄此役的《隋書》《北史》都採帝紀體例，沒有專傳詳述，所以除李景外，官軍將校與郡城守將的姓名都無從考證。
peopleEn: Yang Zhongxu was a man of Zhuo Commandery in Youzhou, a local magnate with real weight in the northern borderlands in the late sixth century, and the leader of the Youzhou rising among the late-Sui rebellions. In the second month of the eleventh year of Daye, on the renchen day, he raised more than ten thousand men and attacked the walled seat of Beiping Commandery; he was cut down when his force was beaten, and the rising collapsed with him. The historical record preserves his name and his end and nothing more — no age, no office, no account of how he mustered his followers — and nothing of that sort should be supplied on his behalf. Li Jing, the man who broke him, was a seasoned Sui general who held the You-Yan frontier. Under Emperor Wen he had already been made a pillar of state and Right Martial Guard Commander, in charge of the imperial guard; in the sixth month of the ninth year of Daye, when Goguryeo troops pressed the rear of the imperial column, the court ordered him to take the rear and cover the withdrawal, holding back the pursuers. He stood more than once on the hardest duties of the emperor's far-flung campaigns and of the exposed northern frontier; by the eleventh year of Daye he was ennobled as Duke of Hua, and in the second month, on the renchen day, he led the army that put down the revolt at Beiping. The same month, the Sui emperor was still moving between the eastern capital and tours of the north and could not come to You-Yan in person; in the eighth month of that same year the Turkic Qaghan Shibi led tens of thousands of horsemen to surround Yamen, the imperial troops fought badly, and it was only in the ninth month that the siege lifted — all of it showing the court's capacity to coordinate the north was already breaking down. Both the Book of Sui and the History of the Northern Dynasties record the affair in annal form without a dedicated biography giving the details, so beyond Li Jing the names of his officers and of the city commandant cannot be recovered.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是秦弩，代表中國弩機最早期而成熟的形態。弩的關鍵在於弩機把拉弓的力先存起來：射手上弦、瞄好之後才扣發，射速遠勝拉弓，穿甲的力道又勝過同樣射程的箭。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外——弩手列在城頭女牆後，事先上弦待發，與弓手交錯輪替，弓負責覆蓋射界，弩負責在攻城隊形逼近城牆的關鍵時刻打出穿甲的一擊。弩矢是消耗品，一具弩一次擊發只得一矢，所以弩的使用必須集中、要點，對應的正是敵人密集舉盾推進的時刻。攻城一方同樣用弩：起義眾多是州縣逃出的軍人，裝備來路雜亂，但繳獲的官軍弩與弩矢同樣可用；守軍用弩壓制，攻城方就以弩仰射城頭，掩護雲梯與撞車靠近。除弩之外，這個時代郡城攻防的常備器械還有撞車、雲梯、火箭與長杆鉤索。糧秣方面，二月的河北地寒，北平郡城若不能自足徵糧，圍城方只能靠就地徵集與小規模襲擾支撐。馬政方面，幽州是北方牧馬地帶，騎兵與弩手混編是李景調兵的常態。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Qin crossbow, the mature form of the Chinese crossbow mechanism at its earliest stage. What matters about a crossbow is that the drawing power is stored in the trigger mechanism: the string is pulled and set first, the marksman sights and only then releases, the rate of fire beats that of the bow by a wide margin, and the punch through armour exceeds what a plain arrow of the same range can do. The defence of a wall depends on it to hold the attackers outside: crossbowmen line the parapet behind the crenellations with their weapons already cocked and alternate with the archers, the bows covering the field of fire while the crossbows deliver the armour-piercing shot at the moment the assault column closes on the wall. Bolts are consumables — a single release yields a single bolt — so crossbow fire has to be concentrated and well aimed, and it is laid against the moment when the enemy is advancing in close order behind shields. The besiegers used crossbows too: most of the insurgents were soldiers who had run away from the prefectures and counties, so their equipment was of mixed and doubtful origin, but crossbows and bolts taken from government stores were equally usable; if the garrison answered with the crossbow, the attackers answered with the crossbow as well, shooting upward at the parapet to cover the scaling ladders and the battering rams. Beyond the crossbow, the standard instruments of a commandery-city siege in this period were the battering ram, the scaling ladder, fire arrows and long hooked poles. As for supply, the Hebei of the second month was bitter cold, and if Beiping could not provision itself from its own fields, the besiegers could live only on local collection and small raids. On the horse question, Youzhou lay in a northern breeding region, so combined arms of riders and crossbowmen were the normal way Li Jing moved his troops.
tactics: 起義方先用奇兵突然起事，在幽州一帶集結，再朝北平方向推進，選擇大業十一年二月、正當隋廷注意力被高句麗戰事與雁門之圍牽制之際動手，圖的是在援軍到達之前拿下北平郡城。攻城序列通常是前排舉盾遮蔽弓弩，後排弩手齊射覆蓋城頭守軍的射界，雲梯靠近城牆、撞車撞擊城門；繳來的弩則用來對城頭射擊，掩護這些攻具。密集的隊形意味著攻城方必須承受集中的箭矢與弩矢。守方的基本形態是據城固守、待援而來。李景所部自薊縣向北平郡城進軍，以騎兵先行偵察，以步卒與弩手結陣接近，把援軍抵達的時間壓在叛軍攻勢最疲的一段上；守軍則以弩居高壓制，使攻城隊形無法展開，最終在郡城外野戰中擊潰叛軍，首領楊仲緒被斬。要說明的是，兩史只留下「破斬之」三個字，沒有記載任何具體陣形、進攻次序與傷亡數字；上面所述的攻防程序，是依隋代郡城防禦的常規做法與弩的器械特性所作的合理還原，並非史書原文。
tacticsEn: The insurgents rose first, concentrated their strength in the Youzhou area, and then moved north toward Beiping, choosing the second month of the eleventh year of Daye precisely when the Sui court's attention was pinned by the Korean campaigns and by the siege of Yamen, in the hope of taking the walled seat before relief could arrive. The normal sequence of a siege runs: shields in front to cover the troops from arrows and bolts, crossbowmen behind firing in volleys to blanket the parapet's field of fire, ladders set against the wall and rams driven at the gates, with the captured crossbows used to shoot up at the defenders so as to cover those engines. Such close order means the attackers must absorb concentrated arrow and bolt fire. The defence is fundamentally to hold the walls and wait for relief. Li Jing's column moved north from Ji County toward the walled seat of Beiping, with cavalry scouting ahead and infantry and crossbowmen closing in column, so that the relief would arrive at the point when the assault had already exhausted itself; the garrison answered with crossbows from the height of the wall, denying the attacking column room to deploy, and the rebels were finally beaten in the field outside the city, where their leader Yang Zhongxu was cut down. It must be said that the two histories leave only the three characters that they 「broke and beheaded him」, and record no formation, no order of attack and no casualty figures. The sequence described above is a reasoned reconstruction from the ordinary practice of commandery-city defence in the Sui period and from the mechanical properties of the crossbow — it is not the wording of the sources.
data: 可核的數字不多，而且多出自帝紀。時間：隋煬帝大業十一年二月戊辰，即公元615年二月；同月丙子又記上谷人王須拔反。兵力：《隋書》卷四作「賊帥揚仲緒率眾萬餘，攻北平，滑公李景破斬之」，《北史》卷十二作「賊帥楊仲緒等率眾萬餘攻北平」；兩書同出一源，「萬餘」是關於起義兵力的唯一量化記載，沒有上萬或不足的細分。主將封爵：滑公李景。地理：北平郡治新昌縣，即今河北盧龍縣一帶；楊仲緒是涿郡人，郡治薊縣，在今北京城西南，兩地相距數百里，郡縣驛傳與騎兵接力是官軍調兵的基本速度。同月北方的另一場大亂：上谷人王須拔自稱漫天王、國號燕，魏刁兒自稱歷山飛，兩部眾各十餘萬。同年的其他數字：二月庚午，隋廷下詔要求各州縣的城民悉令城居、田地就近供給，說明郡城城防與流民問題已被官方視為要務；八月，突厥始畢可汗率騎數十萬包圍雁門，官軍頻戰不利，直到九月甲辰圍解。
dataEn: Verifiable figures are few, and most of them come out of the annals. Date: the renchen day of the second month of the eleventh year of Daye, that is, February 615; the annals also place the revolt of Wang Xu Ba of Shanggu on the bingzi day of the same month. Numbers: the Book of Sui, juan 4, reads 「the rebel leader Yang Zhongxu led more than ten thousand men, attacked Beiping, and the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, broke and beheaded him」; the History of the Northern Dynasties, juan 12, reads 「the rebel leaders Yang Zhongxu and others led more than ten thousand men against Beiping」. Both draw on the same source, and 「more than ten thousand」 is the only quantified statement about the insurgent strength — there is no breakdown of the figure. Title: Li Jing, Duke of Hua. Geography: the seat of Beiping Commandery was Xinchang County, in what is now the area of Lulong in Hebei; Yang Zhongxu was a man of Zhuo Commandery, whose seat was Ji County, southwest of present Beijing. The two places lie several hundred li apart, and relays of post horses and mounted relays set the speed at which the government could move troops. A larger rising in the north in the same month: Wang Xu Ba of Shanggu called himself the King of Lang and founded the state of Yan, while Wei Diao'er called himself the Flying of Lishan, each with more than a hundred thousand men. Other figures from the same year: on the gengwu day of that second month the court issued an edict requiring that in every prefecture and county the population be brought inside the walls and that fields be allotted nearby — a sign that the repair of city defences and the problem of vagrants had become an official concern; in the eighth month the Turkic Qaghan Shibi led tens of thousands of horsemen to surround Yamen, the imperial troops fought badly, and the siege was lifted only on the jiachen day of the ninth month.
cause: 大業十一年，隋朝面對的是一條正在斷裂的邊防線。連續三次征討高句麗耗空了府庫與丁口，兵役與徭役一層層壓到州縣；大業九年楊玄感在黎陽起兵時，天下已經響應，雖然同年被平，河北山東的叛軍此後仍此起彼伏——《隋書》記大業十年就有宋世謨陷琅邪、劉迦論自稱皇王、司馬長安破長平郡等數事。到了大業十一年二月，隋煬帝本人往返於東都與北方巡幸之間，幽燕一線全靠滑國公李景等少數宿將與邊軍支撐，朝廷對當地的實際控制近乎空轉。楊仲緒起兵，得到的就是這樣的土壤：幽州是邊地，軍戶與豪族既有力量也有怨望；多年邊戰留下大量逃兵、逃戶與散兵，聚集在郡縣之外等待編制；而北方同時有王須拔、魏刁兒兩部以十餘萬眾北連突厥的叛亂，說明外部還存在可想像的外援與號令來源。這些都是史書能夠證實的外部條件。至於起義方本身要什麼、以何為號、楊仲緒如何取得眾人擁戴，現存兩史都沒有記錄；這一點只能承認記載有限，不能替它補寫綱領。
causeEn: In the eleventh year of Daye, the Sui faced a frontier line that was breaking. Three campaigns against Goguryeo in succession had drained the treasury and the manpower, and military service and corvée labour were pressed down onto the prefectures and counties layer by layer; when Yang Xuansheng rose at Liyang in the ninth year, the empire had already stirred, and although he was put down that same year, rebellions in Hebei and Shandong continued after him — the Book of Sui records, for the tenth year alone, Song Shimo seizing Langya, Liu Jialun proclaiming himself king, and Sima Chang'an breaking into Changping Commandery. By the second month of the eleventh year the Sui emperor was travelling between the eastern capital and tours of the north, while the You-Yan line was held up by a handful of seasoned commanders such as the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, and the court's real control over the region was close to nominal. Yang Zhongxu's rising rose on exactly such soil: Youzhou was a border region, where military households and local magnates possessed both the means and the grievances; years of frontier war had left large numbers of deserters, absentees and scattered soldiers waiting outside the prefectures for a roster; and in the north the two bands of Wang Xu Ba and Wei Diao'er, with more than a hundred thousand men apiece, reaching towards the Turks, gave the insurgents an imaginable source of outside aid and of higher authority. These are the external conditions the histories can actually establish. What the insurgents themselves demanded, what banner they flew, and how Yang Zhongxu won the adherence of his followers are recorded nowhere in the surviving histories; that limitation should be stated rather than filled in with an invented programme.
impact: 對隋朝而言，這場起義在兩個月內被平掉，邊防體系沒有崩，但它留下的教訓立刻被寫進朝廷的政令：二月庚午的詔書要求各州縣的城民悉令城居、田地就近供給、整修城郭，理由正是「近代戰爭，居人散逸，田疇無伍，郛郭不修」。一次失敗的起義能推動一紙整頓州縣城防的詔令，說明地方城郭與戶籍的鬆弛已被最高層認定為直接導致叛亂的根源。對北方戰局而言，平掉北平不等於平掉河北：同年的十一月，王須拔已攻破高陽郡；大業十二年仍有雁門人翟松柏起兵於靈丘、譙郡人朱粲擁眾數十萬自稱楚帝；到大業十三年，竇建德在河北起兵建國，隋末北方割據的局面已不可逆轉。楊仲緒之死因此只是一個更大崩解過程裡的一個節點。對後世而言，這場戰鬥的意義主要在記錄層面：它是《隋書》與《北史》帝紀中少數留下完整起義、平叛格式的邊地事件之一，兵眾、日期、進攻目標、主將與結局俱全，後人據此可以確認615年二月幽州地區確曾爆發過一次有組織的起兵，也可以確認隋朝在最後的八年中仍具備在邊地快速平叛的軍事能力。
impactEn: For the Sui, the rising was put down within two months and the frontier system did not collapse, but the lesson was written straight into court policy: the edict of the gengwu day in that same month ordered that in every prefecture and county the population be brought inside the walls, that fields be allotted nearby, and that the defences of the cities be repaired, on the stated ground that 「in recent wars the population has scattered, the fields have no households registered, and the city walls are no longer kept in repair」. A failed rising that could push an edict for the reform of the fortified cities of the commanderies shows that the relaxation of the city walls and of the household registers had been identified at the very top as a direct cause of rebellion. For the northern theatre, however, putting down Beiping did not put down Hebei: in the eleventh month of the same year Wang Xu Ba had already broken into Gaoyang Commandery; in the twelfth year there was still the rising of Zhai Songbai at Lingqiu and of Zhu Can, who called himself Emperor of Chu with several tens of thousands of men; and by the thirteenth year of Daye Dou Jiande had raised a state in Hebei, at which point the fragmentation of the north under the Sui had become irreversible. The death of Yang Zhongxu is therefore only one node inside a larger collapse. For later generations the value of this engagement lies mainly in the record: it is one of the few border events preserved in the annals of both the Book of Sui and the History of the Northern Dynasties in the complete rising-and-suppression form, with the numbers, the date, the objective, the commander and the outcome all present, so that later readers can confirm that a mustered revolt did break out in the Youzhou region in February 615, and that the Sui still possessed, in the last eight years of its life, the military capacity to crush a revolt on the frontier quickly.
result: 二月戊辰，楊仲緒以萬餘眾攻北平郡城，李景率官軍應之，攻城未成，叛軍在城外野戰中潰散，楊仲緒本人被斬。起義失敗，北平郡城保住，幽州邊防的這一支叛亂就此終結。記錄的形態同樣是一個結果：《隋書》卷四《帝紀第四》作「賊帥揚仲緒率眾萬餘，攻北平，滑公李景破斬之」，用「揚」字，通行本多作「楊」；《北史》卷十二《隋本紀下》作「賊帥楊仲緒等率眾萬餘攻北平，滑公李景破斬之」，與中文維基百科條目所引一致。兩書都只以帝紀一筆帶過，沒有留下戰役經過、雙方將校名單與損耗數字，楊仲緒在正史中亦無獨立傳記。因此可以確定的結果是：起義領袖陣亡，部眾潰散，郡城未失，隋朝對北平郡的統治維持；而不能確定的是戰役的具體經過——攻城持續多久、官軍出城反擊的時機、弩兵實際如何配置、雙方損耗為何，都只能依常制推測。這場戰爭的記載確實有限，但可以確定的是，它標誌著隋末北方亂局在615年二月仍能被以李景為代表的邊軍迅速壓制，也標誌著隋朝最後幾年對北方郡縣控制的脆弱。
resultEn: On the renchen day of the second month, Yang Zhongxu attacked the walled seat of Beiping Commandery with more than ten thousand men; Li Jing brought up the government troops to meet him, the assault failed, the insurgents broke up in the field outside the city, and Yang Zhongxu was cut down in person. The rising failed, the walled city was held, and this rebellion in the Youzhou border district came to an end. The shape of the record is itself part of the result: the Book of Sui, juan 4, in the Annals of Emperor Yang, reads 「the rebel leader Yang Zhongxu led more than ten thousand men, attacked Beiping, and the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, broke and beheaded him」, with the graph 揚 where the received text commonly has 楊; the History of the Northern Dynasties, juan 12, in the Annals of the Sui, reads 「the rebel leaders Yang Zhongxu and others led more than ten thousand men against Beiping, and the Duke of Hua, Li Jing, broke and beheaded him」, which is what the Chinese Wikipedia article on him cites. Both works touch the affair in a single annalistic line, leaving no account of the course of the battle, no list of officers on either side and no figures for losses; Yang Zhongxu has no independent biography in the official histories either. So the results that can be fixed are these: the insurgent leader was killed, his following dispersed, the commandery seat was not lost, and Sui rule over Beiping Commandery was maintained. What cannot be fixed is how the engagement actually went — how long the assault lasted, when the government troops counter-attacked outside the walls, how the crossbowmen were posted, and what the losses on each side were; these can only be inferred from the ordinary practice of the age. The record for this war is indeed thin, but what can be fixed is that it marks a point at which, in February 615, the disorder in the north could still be suppressed quickly by frontier troops of the kind Li Jing commanded, and equally a point at which the Sui's grip on the northern commanderies had grown fragile.
